nodes.name: Sans-IO core
nodes.responsibility: Defines application setup independent of HTTP serving, including configuration, registries, hooks, and extension points.

nodes.name: WSGI application
nodes.responsibility: Receives a WSGI environment, runs Flask's request lifecycle, produces the response, and tears contexts down.

nodes.name: Application contexts
nodes.responsibility: Creates, pushes, matches, and tears down app and request context state around request execution.

nodes.name: Context globals
nodes.responsibility: Exposes current_app, request, session, and g through context-local variables and proxies.

nodes.name: Routing
nodes.responsibility: Stores URL rules and view mappings, binds them to request environments, and supplies route matches.

nodes.name: Blueprints
nodes.responsibility: Records routes and callbacks without an app, then replays them into an application during registration.

nodes.name: CLI
nodes.responsibility: Defines the flask command group, loads an application, and starts the development server and app commands.

nodes.name: Sessions
nodes.responsibility: Provides session interfaces and the default signed-cookie session implementation for opening and saving session state.

nodes.name: Templating
nodes.responsibility: Loads and renders templates, injects Flask context values, and emits template-rendering signals.

nodes.name: JSON
nodes.responsibility: Serializes and deserializes application data and builds application JSON responses through a provider.

nodes.name: Signals
nodes.responsibility: Defines the event signals for request, app-context, and template lifecycle observers.

nodes.name: Testing
nodes.responsibility: Builds Flask-aware test environments and clients, including preserved contexts and CLI runners.

nodes.name: Werkzeug
nodes.responsibility: Provides the WSGI, request/response, routing, utility, serving, and testing primitives Flask builds on.

nodes.name: Jinja
nodes.responsibility: Provides the template environment, loaders, template selection, and rendering engine.

nodes.name: Click
nodes.responsibility: Provides the command, option, group, context, and CLI runner primitives.

edges.label: extends App
edges.description: Flask in app.py subclasses App from sansio.app.py.

edges.label: push and pop request context
edges.description: wsgi_app creates request_context, calls ctx.push before dispatch, and ctx.pop in finally.

edges.label: dispatch matched view
edges.description: dispatch_request reads request.url_rule and invokes the mapped view; create_url_adapter binds the URL map.

edges.label: save session with response
edges.description: process_response calls session_interface.save_session for the request context session.

edges.label: create JSON response
edges.description: make_response uses the app JSON provider for dict/list return values and JSON responses.

edges.label: request lifecycle events
edges.description: full_dispatch_request and finalize_request send request_started and request_finished; teardown sends request_tearing_down.

edges.label: register URL rules
edges.description: App.add_url_rule constructs a Rule and adds it to self.url_map.

edges.label: instantiate provider
edges.description: App.__init__ creates self.json from json_provider_class.

edges.label: create global loader
edges.description: create_global_jinja_loader returns a DispatchingJinjaLoader for the app and its blueprints.

edges.label: register deferred routes
edges.description: BlueprintSetupState.add_url_rule forwards a blueprint route to app.add_url_rule during Blueprint.register.

edges.label: Map, Rule, and adapter
edges.description: Flask uses Werkzeug Map and Rule and calls bind_to_environ for request URL matching.

edges.label: WSGI request and response primitives
edges.description: The Flask app uses Werkzeug request/response wrappers, HTTP exceptions, headers, and WSGI response behavior.

edges.label: bind context locals
edges.description: AppContext.push and RequestContext.push set the _cv_app and _cv_request context variables.

edges.label: open session
edges.description: RequestContext.push calls session_interface.open_session after binding the request context.

edges.label: app-context events
edges.description: AppContext.push and AppContext.pop send appcontext_pushed and appcontext_popped.

edges.label: LocalProxy
edges.description: globals.py implements Flask proxies with werkzeug.local.LocalProxy.

edges.label: read current context values
edges.description: render_template resolves current_app and template context processors expose request, session, and g.

edges.label: select and render template
edges.description: render_template calls app.jinja_env.get_or_select_template and _render calls template.render.

edges.label: template events
edges.description: _render sends before_render_template before rendering and template_rendered afterward.

edges.label: resolve current app provider
edges.description: The public JSON helpers use current_app.json when an application context is active.

edges.label: commands and options
edges.description: FlaskGroup and AppGroup subclass click groups and define command and option callbacks.

edges.label: start development server
edges.description: run_command passes the loaded app to werkzeug.run_simple.

edges.label: load Flask app
edges.description: ScriptInfo.load_app locates/imports the configured Flask application and returns it to run_command.

edges.label: invoke application
edges.description: FlaskClient.open builds a request and delegates to the underlying Werkzeug client for the application.

edges.label: test client and environ
edges.description: Flask testing subclasses werkzeug.test.EnvironBuilder and Client.
